name: A date that does not exist is rejected with that reason

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today and clears saved trips)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add), enter entry date 2024-02-30 (data-testid=trip-entry) and exit date 2024-03-05 (data-testid=trip-exit), and click save (data-testid=trip-save)
The form error (data-testid=trip-form-error) says the date does not exist
No trip row (data-testid=trip-row) is on the page
